title: cuscuta americana var. congesta
intro: Cuscuta americana var. congesta, commonly known as Dodder, is a parasitic plant that grows by attaching itself to other plants and obtaining nutrients through the host. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cuscuta americana var. congesta include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its overall health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are commonly used in herbal remedies.
